name: Cooler Master ARGB monitors and GD160 desk
description: Per-LED lighting of the Cooler Master GM27-FQS and GM34-CWQ ARGB monitors (47 LEDs) and the GD160 ARGB gaming desk (96 LEDs front, 96 back), in their software mode. Adapted from OpenRGB's CMMonitorController and CMGD160Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Hardware-effect and stored custom-colour writes are never sent; shutdown turns software mode off, back to the device's own effect. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/coolermaster-monitor-desk.md.
